turns:
Ini Pine Script strategi saya (golden cross EMA 20/50 dengan filter Z-score volume, stop loss 5%, take profit 10%, keluar saat death cross). Uji strategi ini di BBRI sejak 2020 dan analisa risk-reward-nya: jumlah trade, win rate, rata-rata untung dan rugi, rasio risk-reward yang benar-benar terjadi, profit factor, drawdown maksimum, serta distribusi return per trade (median, persentil, trade terbaik dan terburuk).

```pine
//@version=5
// Standard: golden cross EMA 20/50 with a volume Z-score filter, long only.
strategy("EMA 20/50 + Volume Z", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000000,
         default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=10)

fastLen = input.int(20, "EMA cepat")
slowLen = input.int(50, "EMA lambat")
zLen    = input.int(20, "Jendela Z-score volume")
zMin    = input.float(2.0, "Z-score volume minimum")
slPct   = input.float(5.0, "Stop loss %") / 100
tpPct   = input.float(10.0, "Take profit %") / 100

emaFast = ta.ema(close, fastLen)
emaSlow = ta.ema(close, slowLen)

// Z-score of today's volume against the previous zLen bars (today excluded)
volMean = ta.sma(volume[1], zLen)
volStd  = ta.stdev(volume[1], zLen)
zVol    = volStd > 0 ? (volume - volMean) / volStd : na

goldenCross = ta.crossover(emaFast, emaSlow)
deathCross  = ta.crossunder(emaFast, emaSlow)

if goldenCross and zVol >= zMin and strategy.position_size == 0
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)

if strategy.position_size > 0
    entry = strategy.position_avg_price
    strategy.exit("SL/TP", "Long", stop=entry * (1 - slPct), limit=entry * (1 + tpPct))

if deathCross
    strategy.close("Long")

plot(emaFast, "EMA 20", color=color.teal)
plot(emaSlow, "EMA 50", color=color.orange)
plotshape(goldenCross and zVol >= zMin, "Sinyal", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.green)
```
